holovm_transport.source_agnostic_distribution_result: Identical source marginals induce identical deterministic HoloVM terminal-state distributions; provenance lives in side information/evidence.

core_result: A deterministic seeded source can be exactly uniform to a seedless observer while remaining perfectly decryptable to the seed holder. Matching output statistics do not identify whether entropy is fundamental, pseudorandom, or externally certified.
boundary: The built-in quantum arm is an ideal distribution reference, not a laboratory randomness certificate. Device-independent or QRNG certification remains an external evidence obligation.
